note: word-passed-facts: which finding of the S5 exit is which FACT a person's recorded word passed (`facts`: the finding's check and tag, exact or prefix), and which tests[] row fields that word may pass (`row_fields`: a field with no row, or a row with pass false, is NEVER passed: the safe default is that the field is deleted when empty and refused as before). The one reader is waiver.word_passed_index (and waiver.row_fields); no other script keeps a (check, tag) list or a field list. A pass whose (check, tag) matches no `facts` row is fact `other`: a report line only, read by no gate. `words` is the wording of each fact for the report.

change_disposition.why: an empty value switches off the probe demand (contract.py probe-missing line; proof_level.proof_required)

input_hash.why: an empty value makes the item malformed_instance and skips every later check of it (acceptance.validate_window)

words.then_unbound: Then not bound to a test
words.other: the finding stays as it was
